title: Book your free demo
lead: Tell us a little about you and when suits you. It's a 30-minute demo: we'll show you Yawmy Care and answer your questions.

name.label: Name
name.required: Add your name so we know who to ask for.

phone.label: Mobile / WhatsApp number
phone.required: Add a mobile or WhatsApp number so we can reach you.
phone.invalid: That number does not look right. Use 8 to 15 digits, and add the country code if you can.

nursery.label: Nursery or school name
nursery.required: Add the name of your nursery or school.

email.label: Email address
email.invalid: That email does not look right. It should look like name@example.com.

date.label: Preferred date
date.required: Pick a day that suits you.
date.invalid: That date does not look right.
date.min: Pick today or a later day.

time.label: Preferred time
time.required: Pick a time that suits you.
time.invalid: That time does not look right.
time.past: That time has passed for today. Pick a later one.

summary: A few fields need a quick fix. We have marked them below.

step2.title: Help us prepare your demo
step2.lead: We will contact you to confirm your demo. A few details help us prepare.
step2.optionalNote: Every field on this step is optional.

done.title: Thank you. We will be in touch.
done.body: We have your details and will contact you to confirm your demo.
next: We will contact you on the number you gave us to confirm a day and time.
Then we will walk you through Yawmy Care and answer your questions.

error.title: Your request has not gone through
error.body: We could not send your request. Check your connection and try again.
error.notConnected: This form is not working yet. Please reach us on WhatsApp or by email instead.
error.tooFast: That went through very fast, so we paused it. Check your details and try once more.
